recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black-and-white group portrait of five individuals, centered around a glowing torch light, contrasted with vibrant magenta-pink hand-drawn typography that features a heavy upward diagonal slant.
coreVisualRelationships: Centralized light source creating a halo effect around the subjects
Vibrant pink accent color against a desaturated grayscale background
Aggressive diagonal tilt of the primary text against the horizontal group alignment
Grainy film texture unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Hand-painted brush stroke quality in lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of five people occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, arranged horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A bright, diffused white light source held by the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright central light, moves down to the faces, then follows the sharp diagonal of the top text upward to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large area of hazy, textured gray in the upper right quadrant.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale and deep blacks in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the central light source and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta-pink for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the zero-saturation background and the high-saturation neon text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: All-caps brush script with a heavy italic slant.
letterConstructionRules: Consistent 30-degree upward diagonal baseline for the main title
Variable stroke width based on simulated pressure
Wide tracking for the secondary text at the bottom
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are connected by a thick, jagged underline that acts as a secondary baseline stroke.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching script styles with contrasting scale and tracking.

avoid: Primary colors like red or blue

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, textured brush feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black and white photograph of a rock band sitting together. A central figure holds a glowing torch that creates a soft, blown-out white halo in the center of the frame. The lighting should be dramatic chiaroscuro with deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom magenta-pink brush lettering. The main title should be large, top-left, and slanted upwards. The secondary title should be small, wide-tracked, and placed along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the light source the brightest point in the image?
Is the pink color vibrant and consistent across all text?
Does the top text have a significant upward diagonal tilt?
Is there a visible film grain across the entire composition?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
Brightness of the central light halo
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact letterforms of the original logo
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not have a drop shadow.
Check that the grain is not too digital/uniform.
Verify the magenta color pops against the gray background.
Confirm the central light source creates a 'glow' effect on the faces.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Grayscale Chiaroscuro Photography] + [Central Diffused Light Source] + [Heavy Film Grain] + [Slanted Magenta Brush Lettering].
